# Chapter 2

Date: 2026-03-01

## Scenes

### 002.01 The Pens

The party woke in the pens of Velkynvelve. Sarith held the gate and watched them through the bars, and Kalan fled down the east stair before the guards could hold him.

#### The party takes stock of the pens.

- Sarith is alive and holds the gate.

### 002.02 A Visitor

Ilvara Mizzrym came to the bars at dusk. She said, "The web remembers every debt," and left a signet ring on the floor.

#### Ilvara makes an offer.

- Ilvara leaves the signet ring.
